notes: Major code MA31 (spelled "Mathematics—Applied Science" in the General Catalog). Fourteen upper-division courses (fifty-six units): seven from Mathematics and seven from one or two other departments. Students must have an individual plan approved by a mathematics department adviser before starting the applied-science course work.

buckets.label: Calculus and linear algebra sequence
buckets.note: One of two sequences: MATH 18 and 20A-B-C-D-E, or Honors Calculus MATH 31AH-BH-CH with MATH 20D (31AH-BH-CH cover MATH 18, 20C and 20E). The count shown is the standard six-course sequence; on the honors path four courses complete it.

buckets.label: Mathematical Reasoning
buckets.note: MATH 109. Students completing MATH 31AH-BH-CH may substitute a four-unit upper-division mathematics elective.

buckets.label: One two-quarter upper-division mathematics sequence
buckets.note: One complete sequence from the catalog list (MATH 100A-B, 103A-B, 103A-102, 104A-B, 110-130, 110-148, 111A-B, 112A-B, 120A-B, 130-146, 146-148, 150A-B, 154-184, 155A-B, 158-188, 160A-B, 170A-B, 171A-B, 173A-B, 174-175, 174-179, 180A-B, 180A-194, 181A-B, 187A-B, 190A-B, 193A-B). The audit counts two upper-division mathematics courses — check that yours form one of those sequences.

buckets.label: Additional upper-division mathematics electives
buckets.note: Chosen from any mathematics course numbered 100–194. The count here is what remains AFTER the required upper-division courses above, which also count toward the total. MATH 195–199 may not be used toward any mathematics major.

buckets.label: Applied-science course work (seven upper-division courses, 28 units)
buckets.note: Seven upper-division courses from one or two departments OTHER than mathematics, at least three of which require MATH 20B or later as a prerequisite. The department approves these individually, so this audit cannot check them — confirm with your mathematics adviser.
